_comment: Each rule computes one auto-generated row's time as an offset from a known 'anchor' time. anchor must match a value the itinerary tool actually has for that day (e.g. flight_departure, flight_arrival, hotel_checkin). offset_minutes is negative for 'before anchor', positive for 'after anchor'. Add new rules here as later stages introduce new anchors (e.g. activity_start, dinner_time) - no code changes needed for a new rule, only a new entry below.
